comment: Scene list for the menu and for /<id> links. 'base' is relative to this file; point it at an absolute URL (CDN or bucket) to host scenes elsewhere — that host must send CORS headers, and byte ranges for .nxs4 streaming. 'cam' is the opening view (yaw/pitch/roll radians, dolly in scene radii, pan, fov degrees); 'transform' places the scene ({rotate:[x,y,z] degrees, translate:[x,y,z], scale}); 'limits' clamps yaw/pitch/dolly. After editing, run node tools/build_pages.mjs to refresh 404.html and the per-scene pages.
